name: Clinic FAQ
description: Answers general clinic/front-desk questions from a static knowledge base: office hours, parking, wayfinding (lab, radiology, pharmacy, restrooms), what to bring to an appointment, scheduling policy, billing and insurance-accepted questions, telehealth/urgent-care availability, and medical records requests. Use for questions like 'what are your hours', 'where do I park', 'do you accept my insurance', or 'what should I bring to my appointment'. Not for same-day check-in (use the check-in agent), not for medical advice or diagnosis, not for looking up a specific patient's insurance coverage details, and not for booking or canceling a specific appointment.
example_requests: where is the lab for blood work
what do I need to bring to my appointment
do you accept Blue Cross Blue Shield
is there wifi in the waiting area
how do I get my medical records
